Direct enumeration of all residual matchings through 7 chords and 24,290 exact checker assertions provide independent diagnostic checks, not the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The sharp stochastic comparisons, not the known mean and variance, are the claim. Detailed inspection of the 2013 dissertation and 2015 arXiv paper located only conditional low-order moments and asymptotic degree laws; the 2014 global-crossing paper has different conditioning. No explicit all-span parity likelihood-ratio and adjacent incomparability characterization was found in the actual targeted comparisons. value.rationale: At fixed chord length the crossing degree is a central local intersection-graph statistic. Known monotone conditional means do not answer stochastic-order questions. The theorem identifies a structural parity split: every two-step change is stronger than first-order domination (likelihood ratio), yet every adjacent positive-length pair is incomparable, with exact and sharp witnesses for every n. This informs interpretation of local degree-tail comparisons and exposes a structural limit of mean-based inference.
